legs.name: Story: The Road to the Finale
legs.note: Every story mission, in order. All 12 are missable: finish each leg before its phase ends, and keep a save from before the final mission.

legs.name: Strangers & Freaks
legs.note: Stranger strands and Bret's hunt. Do these as they open, between story chapters, so none is left behind.

legs.name: Leonida on Wheels & Wings
legs.note: Races, stunts, drones, fishing, arcade and bowling. Short sessions, best done while the map is open to you.

legs.name: Vice City Playground
legs.note: Wanted levels, robberies, money and vehicles. The loud half of the platinum — play it with a partner where the description says so.

legs.name: The Collector
legs.note: 52 areas, garages, cards, spots and the range. Slow, steady, and best tracked as you go.

legs.name: The Long Grind
legs.note: 100%, 50 challenges and the vague ones. Leave these for the endgame, when everything is unlocked.

legs.name: Platinum
legs.note: One trophy, earned by earning the other 54.

list: The official 55 trophies as Exophase and PSNProfiles publish them (names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them). Every guide below is written fresh for this entry from the official description; where a place or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so instead of inventing one.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (official names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (grades and PSN progress counts)
Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the seven legs in order and it arrives on its own. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our route is our own advice from the official list, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is the first story trophy on the route, so earn it as the story presents it and do not skip the opening. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapters are the route's backbone: clear the chapter before moving on to side content, so no chapter trophy is left behind. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2. Keep a save from before the chapter's final mission: if a story trophy ever fails to pop, that save is your way back without replaying the game. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3. By now the map is opening up — resist the urge to wander off for collectibles until the chapter trophy is banked. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale leg, so treat the chapter's final mission as a checkpoint: save first, then play it. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end — this gold trophy is the story's payoff. Keep a save from before it: the finale is the last point at which a missed story trophy can still be recovered by replaying from a save. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when the story offers it. Named-mission trophies like this one only pop from that mission, so take it the first time it appears rather than leaving it for later. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to be long and gated by preparation, so start it with a clear session ahead of you and save before the first setup step. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it pops only from that mission, so play it when it unlocks and check it off here right away. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. If a mission trophy does not pop, replay the mission from a save made before it rather than pushing on and hoping it appears later. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the airport, so expect a vehicle-heavy mission; bring your best driving and save before it starts. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last named-mission trophy in Leg 1 — once it pops, the whole story leg is banked and the finale gold is the only story trophy left. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which the game tracks across story, strangers, activities and collectibles — it is the second gold and the real endgame. Do not chase it early: it completes itself as the other legs do, and the last few percent are usually the collectibles in Leg 5. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. This is a volume trophy: it builds up naturally while driving hard, so do not grind it in one sitting; let the count climb across Legs 3 and 4. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The description does not name the nine, so work through the ones the list already gives you — races, drones, fishing, arcade, bowling, shooting range, stunts, meditation and challenges — and tick this off when the last new type registers. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count comes from PSNProfiles. This is the hardest silver: learn one weapon type at a time, repeat the challenge you are weakest at, and leave it for the endgame when your aim and upgrades are at their best. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles (42 challenges per PSNProfiles); our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PSNProfiles — official name, description, grade; 42 challenges
Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own win, so treat it as a tour: one location per session, learning its gates before racing it for the win. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Vary the vehicle and the event, and count distinct wins here as you go so you know when you are done. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is introduced by the opening mission Gone Fishing, so you will already know the basics — challenge Cal when the option appears and keep your line steady through his best catch. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and learn its rules first — a full playthrough counts, a quick look does not. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you meet people across Leonida — return to Andy whenever his marker appears, and do not leave a strand half-finished for chapters at a time. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand through to its final mission. The strand's missions appear in order, so clear each one when it shows up; the trophy pops on the last. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is one of the seven in Leg 2 — work the strands in parallel and tick each final mission off as it lands. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands in full — the silver that caps Leg 2. There are more strangers than eight, so pick the strands you have already started and finish them; this pops when the eighth strand's final mission ends. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand through to its final mission. If a strand marker stops appearing, check the map across Leonida — strands wait for you, but they only advance when you visit them. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's strand counts toward the eight in Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it is progress on two trophies at once. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are spread over the whole map, so pair this with exploring the 52 areas in Leg 5 — meditate whenever you reach a new spot rather than hunting all 18 at the end. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. The description names no species or place, and we will not invent one: follow Bret's strand until he marks the hunt, then track the animal he names. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you travel rather than sweeping at the end, and keep sets together — a finished set is what counts, not a pile of loose cards. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — the silver for the photo-style collectible. The count is large, so make it a habit: WAiNK It at every new place you visit and the total climbs without a dedicated grind. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges span combat, driving and activities, so this fills itself while you play the other legs — check the challenge list in the endgame and clear the easiest fifty first. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Stay together through the escape — the trophy needs your partner with you when the heat drops, so do not split up mid-chase. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — keep the heat alive between shops and move fast. Plan a route of three close shops first, then run it in one go. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you drive counts, so vary what you steal and drive — the count climbs fastest when you take something different instead of your usual ride. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus with a full meter, and chain the five — a crowded fight is the place to try it, not a lone enemy. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description is a joke with a clear setting: get to the airport, take a plane that is not yours, and leave. Expect a wanted level on the way out. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description gives no step, so our advice is only from its words: find a Rhino, survive it, and use heavy weapons or a hijack when the chance comes; we have not checked the exact step in the game. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, in and out before anyone knows. Save before you try, so a detection costs you a reload, not the attempt. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — the silver for the biggest robberies. Bank vaults are the hardest heists in the open world, so gear up, plan the escape route before you go in, and count each clean escape here. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks run set routes, so ambush one away from police, crack it fast, and have a getaway car pointed at open road before you start. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so drive every road and visit every corner — pair this with the meditation spots and WAiNK It locations and the map completes itself. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang, nine in total — keep a list of which gangs you have hit so the last one is easy to find. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This one is pure flavour: go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail — the easiest trophy in Leg 4. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — through the glass, in a car, the way the series has always done it. Pick a showroom, take a car, and drive out through the front. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The description names the alley, so go there and bowl a full game — follow-through means finishing the game, not one throw. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague by design, and we will not invent a step: it reads as a partner-activity trophy, so play partner content and watch for the pop; the exact trigger is not pinned down by the official description. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks this one to a count of 500. Choices happen all through the game, so this fills as you play; the missable part is that some choices only appear once, so weigh the big story choices instead of rushing past them. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles (PSN count 500); our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PSNProfiles — official name, description, grade; PSN count 500
Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The description is a riddle — it reads as retrying something you failed and passing it the second time. Fail honestly once at a challenge or mission, then pass it on the immediate retry. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description is deliberately vague — Leonida hides odd events, and this pops when you stumble into one. Explore off the beaten path and let it find you; we have not checked any single trigger in the game. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee hit from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and keep the speed low enough to aim. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, so this follows naturally from Leg 4's heists — launder through your contacts as the bills pile up rather than sitting on them. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades all count, so spend as you play instead of hoarding cash — by the endgame this is usually already done. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages cost money, so save for them through Leg 4's robberies and buy each one as you can afford it — the trophy pops on the eighth. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app and register each — it pairs neatly with discovering 100 vehicles, so register as you discover. Source: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; our advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
